notes: Only es_value_o and pval_value_o are assigned. Experiment 2 Results describes decreasing RT with velocity but prints no main-effect statistic or p for velocity. Fig. 3 gives mean RT with 95% confidence limits, not a velocity test statistic or p. The printed F (4, 12) = .774, p = .562 is explicitly the stimulus-uncertainty × velocity interaction and cannot fill the target main-effect fields. Canonical interaction evidence: there is no interaction between stimu- ... lus uncertainty and velocity [F (4, 12) D .774, p D .562, ... repeated measures ANOVA]. Experiment 1 statistics and Experiment 3 interaction are different studies/tests. No effect conversion or N derivation performed; all unassigned fields are placeholders.
